text: Our NAIRR Pilot project has been funded.
Welcome Aagat Pokhrel to the team!
Our team was selected for a DOE Genesis Mission Phase I award.
DeepCQ has been accepted at IEEE Cluster 2026. Congratulations to Khondoker Mirazul Mumenin and our collaborators!
Our NAIRR Classroom project has been funded.
Rethinking the Potential of Layer Freezing for Efficient DNN Training is available on arXiv.
NeurLZ has been accepted at ICS 2025.
NRDPISI-2 workshop call for papers announced.
Serving on the technical program committee of ICDE 2025.
QualityNet has been accepted at IEEE BigData 2024. Congratulations to Khondoker Mirazul Mumenin and our collaborators!
Organizing NRDPISI-1 in conjunction with eScience 2024.
Joining UNC Charlotte as a tenure-track Assistant Professor.
Serving on the technical program committees of SDM 2024 and CCGrid 2024.
zPerf has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Computers.
Improving Progressive Retrieval for HPC Scientific Data using Deep Neural Network has been accepted at ICDE 2023.
Our study of lossy data reduction and cosmology volume rendering has been accepted at DRBSD-8.
Joining Los Alamos National Laboratory as a summer research intern.
Compression ratio modeling and estimation across error bounds for lossy compression has been accepted by IEEE TPDS.
